instructions: Make two separate two-cube towers, each {small_base.color} below {small_top.color}. Pair the smaller cube of each colour together and the larger cube of each colour together.
Stack the smaller {small_top.color} cube on the smaller {small_base.color} cube, and the larger {small_top.color} cube on the larger {small_base.color} cube, making two towers.
Build one tower from the smaller cube of each colour and another from the larger cube of each colour. In both towers, {small_base.color} goes below {small_top.color}.
The goal is two size-rank-matched towers: smaller {small_base.color} under smaller {small_top.color}, and larger {small_base.color} under larger {small_top.color}.

Compare sizes within each colour. Put the smaller {small_top.color} cube on its smaller {small_base.color} partner, then put the larger {small_top.color} cube on its larger {small_base.color} partner.
Arrange the cubes into two separate stacks with bottom-to-top colour order {small_base.color}, then {small_top.color}; match smaller with smaller and larger with larger across the colours.

Make exactly two separate towers of two cubes each: place the smaller {small_top.color} cube on the smaller {small_base.color} cube and the larger {small_top.color} cube on the larger {small_base.color} cube.
Please pair the cubes by size within their colours, smaller with smaller and larger with larger, and build two separate two-block stacks with {small_base.color} underneath {small_top.color}.
notes: Builds two simultaneous colour-ordered towers by matching relative size ranks within two colour groups.
